beats.narration_text: Hi, I am Deepa Shenoy, and this video is about how data can shape AI decisions. This is Liam, narrating for Deepa.

beats.narration_text: Machine-learning systems learn patterns from examples to produce outputs for a task; they do not independently decide what the world should look like. People set tasks, labels, and measurements.

shot.visual_intent: Illustrated example tiles feed a model that identifies repeatable patterns; a small caption distinguishes model fitting from human task choices.

beats.narration_text: Training-data quality and composition matter. Incomplete or unrepresentative examples may leave relevant conditions absent. That is a possible issue to evaluate, not an automatic outcome.

shot.visual_intent: Compare a broad set of conditions with gaps in a second set; use neutral, non-quantified data tiles.
shot.layout_plan: Compare a broad set of conditions with gaps in a second set; use neutral, non-quantified data tiles. Native landscape composition with readable hierarchy, concise labels, and safe margins.

beats.narration_text: Sampling concerns which examples are collected and how. Data can also reflect historical or institutional patterns. NIST treats bias as involving data, measurement, and human or organizational context.

shot.visual_intent: Sampling funnel selects examples from varied origins; faint repeated contextual motifs illustrate possible historical patterns.
shot.layout_plan: Sampling funnel selects examples from varied origins; faint repeated contextual motifs illustrate possible historical patterns. Native landscape composition with readable hierarchy, concise labels, and safe margins.

beats.narration_text: Labels and measurements need review. A proxy label may not capture the intended concept; construct validity asks whether a measure represents what it is meant to.

shot.visual_intent: A label card and measurement gauge are compared against the intended concept; a validity check links the two.
shot.layout_plan: A label card and measurement gauge are compared against the intended concept; a validity check links the two. Native landscape composition with readable hierarchy, concise labels, and safe margins.

beats.narration_text: Training conditions may differ from deployment: lighting, camera angle, equipment, or other inputs can shift. Research on distribution shift studies how such mismatches may affect performance.

shot.visual_intent: Training and deployment panels contrast conditions; changing light, viewpoint, or gear is shown as distribution shift, without performance numbers.
shot.layout_plan: Training and deployment panels contrast conditions; changing light, viewpoint, or gear is shown as distribution shift, without performance numbers. Native landscape composition with readable hierarchy, concise labels, and safe margins.

beats.narration_text: Fictional example: a vision system learns to recognize required safety equipment in worker photos, such as hard hats and reflective vests. Suppose most training images show similar workplaces, lighting, camera angles, and equipment. It may learn patterns for those represented settings.

shot.visual_intent: Prominent FICTIONAL EXAMPLE label; abstract workplace photo tiles depict hard hats and reflective vests under limited represented conditions.
shot.layout_plan: Prominent FICTIONAL EXAMPLE label; abstract workplace photo tiles depict hard hats and reflective vests under limited represented conditions. Native landscape composition with readable hierarchy, concise labels, and safe margins.

beats.narration_text: Under glare, from a different angle, or with unfamiliar equipment, its performance may change. That outcome must be tested; this illustration is not evidence about a real company or system.

shot.visual_intent: Condition panels change lighting, angle, and equipment; an output indicator reads “may differ,” never a fabricated score.
shot.layout_plan: Condition panels change lighting, angle, and equipment; an output indicator reads “may differ,” never a fabricated score. Native landscape composition with readable hierarchy, concise labels, and safe margins.

beats.narration_text: One overall score describes a particular evaluation set, but may not show results for every relevant condition or group. Evaluate conditions similar to intended use, examine appropriate groups, and investigate meaningful differences; no single metric answers every question.

shot.visual_intent: An aggregate summary card expands into separate condition and relevant-group evaluation views; use no scores or statistics.
shot.layout_plan: An aggregate summary card expands into separate condition and relevant-group evaluation views; use no scores or statistics. Native landscape composition with readable hierarchy, concise labels, and safe margins.

production_viz.label: Look beyond one number
production_viz.mechanic: An aggregate summary card expands into separate condition and relevant-group evaluation views; use no scores or statistics.
production_viz.note: Evidence-led explanatory graphics; no generic AI filler, real-incident imagery, fabricated numbers, or unsupported claims.

beats.narration_text: Review how data was collected and what it represents; check labels and measurements; then test under relevant conditions. If differences appear, investigate their causes and consider adjusting data, model design, or evaluation.

shot.visual_intent: Review loop: data collection → representation → labels/measurement → relevant testing → investigate → improve.
shot.layout_plan: Review loop: data collection → representation → labels/measurement → relevant testing → investigate → improve. Native landscape composition with readable hierarchy, concise labels, and safe margins.

production_viz.label: Evaluation and mitigation
production_viz.mechanic: Review loop: data collection → representation → labels/measurement → relevant testing → investigate → improve.
production_viz.note: Evidence-led explanatory graphics; no generic AI filler, real-incident imagery, fabricated numbers, or unsupported claims.

beats.narration_text: Continue monitoring after deployment, because conditions and inputs can change. Testing and mitigation may reduce identified problems, but cannot guarantee that every source of bias or error is eliminated.

shot.visual_intent: Monitoring timeline observes new inputs and sends findings back to evaluation; limitation note: reduce risk, not guarantee elimination.

beats.narration_text: Takeaway: outputs reflect more than algorithms; data, measurements, assumptions, evaluation, and conditions of use matter too. How Data Can Shape AI Decisions. This is Liam, narrating for Deepa, for Humanitarians AI.
